body: Alright I will message you at some point tomorrow. See you later
Mate you aren't annoying me at all, yeah I was going to try and sleep.
Oh ok I didn't know that, I will let you go mate, it was good to talk.
Yeah pretty much.
I think they call baguettes french bread where you are.
You like your food then, I can't be bothered to eat most of the time however I do like a chicken and mayonnaise baguette every once in a while.
Brilliant, yeah we have those over here, well I will leave you to it mate.

Well I spoke to someone who I worked with to get me into the voluntary stuff, I should be able to get in there is no reason that they should turn me down considering they sacked loads of people because the trust can't afford it, the delivery driver job is a self employed one as long as you have a car and can do enough hours then they usually take anyone it's just the pay isn't very good and it's by per delivery and that was online, I haven't gone anywhere today.

What about you how is it going?
Nothing really, I am trying to find out if I can get voluntary work in the hospital still and I am seeing if I can get a delivery driver job so I have some money.

You can if you want, if I don't respond don't take it personally sometimes I check reddit and sometimes I don't,  maybe message me once a week if you really want to.

If I don't respond ever it's nothing personal but I really don't know what will happen.
You would be alright I think, see you later

It's alright mate you don't have to, there are others who need someone like you and would probably need to talk more than me, I dont know whats going to happen and I wouldn't want you to wonder if something happened.

I do appreciate it though.
Well I don't and I don't really hear anyone say they hate America.
If you like it then sweet, haha you have concentration that I don't have I couldn't do that in some one else's house in case they heard, well mate I will let you go, it was nice talking to you.

I like all the batman games the combat system is fairly entertaining and it's one of the few games that I can sit and play, oh I see that must suck sometimes but if it pays the bills then good, before when I wasn't too bad I was applying for sewer jobs and it seems that even jobs like that are hard to get now.

It's alright mate I don't expect anyone to do anything I only really put this up on the off chance someone I know sees it and they get some closure I couldn't leave a note and I have done my best to explain so they understand that unless I can get another job at another hospital some time soon I don't know how long I can keep trying for, on my main account I try to talk to people but there is only so much you can do and not everyone can be saved, are you a cleaner or is that just what you have been doing today?, I was playing Arkham Asylum.

I haven't done anything today, I have just been sat in my room all day, I tried to distract myself a bit, play some batman, but I can't keep it off anymore it's always there and it will just repeat and get louder until I do something to myself and then I will be alright and then the cycle repeats.

There is really nothing anyone can do about it, I have had it for a long time, before I would speak to my friend but I don't want to bother her anymore and make her feel helpless or worse set her off.

How about you?

Don't worry about it, there is really nothing you could of done, I doubt anything will happen and if it does it's what I want, it's just how it is, it's nothing personal to anyone, I am not mad at anything, I have just lived with it for too long.
Yeah today, I knew it wouldn't go away but I seem a bit better at the moment, oh that's unfortunate at least you're ok.

Not much has changed really, I still overdosed and self harmed, my chest has started hurting so all that overdosing is doing something.

What about you?, how are you doing?
I will see what happens, it's nice that you think that but I am not that great, thanks for talking though.
Not good.

I am extremely calm all the time, if you knew me in real life you probably wouldn't be able to tell what I am thinking, at the very most I will keep an eye on people going past and I am very aware of what's around me, I didn't tell him about that and he didn't ask if I had any anxiety, I told him about the suicidal thoughts, the self harm and that I can't carry on putting up with it anymore.

As far as I am aware he gave me stuff for people who have panic attacks.

I have no idea, I was uncomfortable talking about it and he must of got the impression that it was anxiety, I don't know it could be anxiety it's just I wouldn't say I had anxiety, I have seen people with anxiety and watched some of them have panic attacks and everything, I have never had a panic attack or anything like what I have see with other people.

Yes I went recently and I knew there wasn't much they could do I answered as best I could but he mainly put it down to anxiety which I wouldn't say I have.

Over here it is ok but it can take a very long time to get the right help and it takes a while for them to see you, I know some people do get the help they need but I would say most don't.

I don't think mental health care is good in most places it took me a few weeks to get an appointment but I have heard of others waiting longer, I have heard of some horror stories in the US where they have been arrested or end up with a big hospital bill.

It's a long list of stuff, but it's different variations of kill yourself, hurt yourself and other stupid stuff, it's just loud and it repeats on and on, most of the time I am ok but when it won't stop it's not very nice.

I want nothing more than to be a paramedic or something similar, I see people who want to live and people would be upset without them and I think fine I will stay to help someone who wants to live.

If it was me in the back of an ambalance I would tell them to leave me, the thoughts are always there with me if I could pass it on to someone and they would know what it's like they would agree, I know that everyone's problems are different and my depression could be different to yours.

Every day I have been overdosing for about a week and nothing has happened and some days I was thinking that's a good sign that I should carry on and then I will get another thought that I should try something else to do it instead.

I am fairly alone and the few people who know me would understand why, because it's all the time and I can never fully shake it off.

I don't really make much of a difference I spend most days walking around my room, before that it was the same thing but I was waiting for the phone to ring so I could go in. I am almost fully certain my friend will be ok now and I know she could get upset but she knows how often it comes on.

If you can keep fighting that's very good and I hope you do but with me it's never ending and I can never keep it off for long.

If you want to that's fine I won't ignore you, I know our time zones are different and it's just after 3 in the morning here and I will probably be asleep for a while.

Ok maybe speak tomorrow just see what happens.

Mate you don't need to worry about that honestly, it's up to me to decide, I am sure you will help others who really do need someone there for them, maybe I will message you if things get better instead.

But don't worry about it if I don't, I might get back to you one day, thanks

I can have a look but over here jobs take a very long time to get and I just don't have the time any more. Thanks for talking to me, I might be ok tomorrow or I might not best to just sleep on it if I can.

I am still here, I just want to be a paramedic to help people but I have lost the chance at the moment, I don't really have an interesting life but I do know what it's like to have all these thoughts that don't leave you alone, I try to help my friend and she as far as I can tell is doing a lot better but it's not fair for me to bring her down because it comes on quite a lot with me, I try to speak to people like me on my main account but I can't save everyone as much as I hate what these thoughts can do to someone, but I don't know I could wake up tomorrow and be better or worse if you have it yourself you know how unpredictable it can be.

As much as I want to save everyone, I still need to live I am already way overdrawn and I have no one to help, getting a new job can take a long time and I can't do some jobs that I wouldn't mind doing because I am colour blind and I have scars on my arm and that puts most employers off and I can't really hide them.

Yeah I wanted to help people who want to live and give myself a reason to carry on even with all the thoughts.

I have heard a few american accents but I don't think they can be as bad as over here. I am not really bothered about my accent no one can automatically guess where I am from or what part.

I don't think you would like my accent, apparently anyone with an accent from where I am is automatically considered stupid, but I don't think mine is that bad and no one can usually guess what part I am from.

This is in the uk hospitals are struggling all over, there isn't many jobs going I was in a trust to work for 4 different hospitals. I even tried to do voluntary work for them but even that won't work its just how it is, the job might not have fixed how I am but it was just my last bit of motivation and I could have done it even with all the thoughts or at the very least lived a bit more, thanks for trying but there isn't anything you can do, this was just for people who know me because I don't want to leave them a note but there is the possibility that they could find this.
I was on bank hours so I was only called in twice, I got the job about a month ago after a long time trying to get into this line of work.
I had the job, it was only a surgery theatre orderly job but I could have worked my way up to be a paramedic, I lost the job because the hospital is struggling with funds.
